Amazon's Quick Commerce Business Grows Rapidly in India

Amazon's quick commerce business in India is experiencing rapid growth, reaching a $1 billion annual revenue run rate. This segment has become Amazon's fastest-growing business within the country. The company is expanding its quick commerce operations further into India.
